capture_method: CoreGraphics CGGetActiveDisplayList + CGDisplayBounds (yabai-free; yabai aborts under separate-Spaces OFF)
coordinate_space: CGDisplayBounds (top-left origin, main@0,0; == AX kAXPosition space)

usable_rects.note: main: menu-bar floor y=57 measured via AX clamp; Dock reservation untested
external: no menu bar, full rect usable; Dock untested

notes: L-shaped/stepped canvas. Displays do not overlap in area; they touch only along the y=0 seam over x in [1930, 2880) -- a 950px-wide bridge, the only dead-zone-free crossing between displays.
A naive bounding-box layout would drop ~42% of frames into dead zones. Geometry must reason over the display-rect set + this dead-zone mask, never the bounding box (design 2, I5).

AX reframe battery (parcel/tools/ax-reframe probe, 2026-05-25, target=Messages): cross-display reframe is PIXEL-EXACT on both displays incl external negative-y. WindowServer clamps dead-zone frames OUT (window won't rest invisible) but unpredictably -- nearest display in the same x-column, to the menu-bar floor, sometimes a sliver. So the engine MUST enforce I5 itself; the clamp is an erratic jump, not a safety net. App min-size is real (Messages min width ~660).
